summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by NXT Energy Solutions Inc. to furnish an Annual and Special Meeting notice and related materials. The attached press release from Computershare sets the meeting date for June 9, 2026, with record dates of April 21, 2026, and details notice-and-access procedures for beneficial and registered holders. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is described. This is a routine proxy-related filing under Canadian securities law, mapped to a US-equivalent proxy statement or information circular. There are no deal terms.
